gates.focused_command: uv run --offline pytest -q tests/test_audit_signed_test_execution.py tests/test_signed_test_execution.py tests/test_local_replay_sandbox.py

synthetic_controls: A valid signature over fabricated stdout and artifact digests still leaves the existing engine signed_passed, but the local repeat audit reports observed_locally false and exits 1.
A deterministic command writes a declared artifact; the repeat audit matches exit code, timeout, stdout, stderr and artifact bytes and reports observed_passed true.
Absent, altered and symlinked artifacts fail the byte check; executable pin or signed argv changes fail before a successful audit.
A signed nonzero result can match the local observation while observed_passed stays false; timeout and unavailable sandbox do not pass.
Run directory symlinks in ancestor or final components are rejected.

independent_read_only_review.finding: No blocking false green within the declared local-repeat scope; the reviewer noticed ancestor symlinks were initially accepted by the path check.
independent_read_only_review.repair_and_recheck: Component-wise O_NOFOLLOW directory opens reject ancestor and final symlinks; the 11 auditor-file tests passed on recheck.
independent_read_only_review.remaining_limit: Same-UID races remain outside the claim; a local repeat cannot prove historical execution or independent key custody.
